questions.question: Who became the first president under the U.S. Constitution in 1789?
choices: John Adams
Thomas Jefferson
George Washington
James Madison

questions.question: Which official developed the early federal government's major financial program?
choices: Alexander Hamilton
John Marshall
James Monroe
Patrick Henry

questions.question: Which two political groups became major rivals in the 1790s?
choices: Whigs and Republicans
Democrats and Progressives
Know-Nothings and Populists
Federalists and Democratic-Republicans

questions.question: Which protest challenged a federal excise tax on distilled spirits in 1794?
choices: Shays' Rebellion
Whiskey Rebellion
Bacon's Rebellion
Dorr Rebellion

questions.question: What position did Washington announce toward war between Britain and France in 1793?
choices: Neutrality
An alliance with France
An alliance with Britain
A declaration of war on both powers

questions.question: What was the XYZ Affair?
choices: A court dispute over western land
A rebellion against state income taxes
A diplomatic controversy involving French demands for payments
A treaty purchasing Florida from Spain

questions.question: Which laws passed in 1798 included restrictions on criticism of the federal government?
choices: Navigation Acts
Intolerable Acts
Townshend Acts
Alien and Sedition Acts

questions.question: Why did Hamilton favor federal assumption of state Revolutionary War debts?
choices: To transfer federal powers to colonial governors
To strengthen national credit and support for the new government
To cancel every debt without repayment
To prohibit future borrowing by private businesses

questions.question: Why did Jefferson and Hamilton disagree about a national bank?
choices: They differed over constitutional interpretation and federal power
They disagreed over whether Britain had won independence
They supported different dates for Washington's inauguration
They wanted the same institution placed in different colonies

questions.question: What did Washington's response to the Whiskey Rebellion demonstrate?
choices: Congress could no longer pass taxes
States could ignore any federal law
The federal government could enforce its laws
The president had abolished civilian courts

questions.question: Why was Washington's decision to leave office after two terms significant?
choices: It created a constitutional two-term limit immediately
It removed the need for future presidential elections
It gave Congress permanent authority to select presidents
It set a precedent for voluntarily relinquishing executive power

questions.question: Why did many Democratic-Republicans oppose the Sedition Act?
choices: It lowered tariffs on imported manufactured goods
They saw it as a threat to speech and political opposition
It expanded voting rights to new groups
They believed it weakened federal courts by closing them

questions.question: Why was the transfer of power after the election of 1800 important?
choices: A rival political group took power through an election
The presidency became hereditary
The Constitution was replaced by a monarchy
State governments stopped holding elections

questions.question: How did the Judiciary Act of 1789 help the new government function?
choices: It transferred all trials to state legislatures
It selected presidential electors
It organized the lower federal court system
It created a new constitutional convention

questions.question: What did the cabinet practice begun under Washington provide?
choices: A second national legislature
A permanent council of state governors
A group that replaced the Supreme Court
Department leaders who advised the president

questions.question: A merchant favors a national bank and a strong federal government in the 1790s. Which group most closely matches these views?
choices: Democratic-Republicans
Federalists
Anti-Masonic Party
Free Soil Party

questions.question: Which comparison best distinguishes the Whiskey Rebellion from Shays' Rebellion?
choices: Whiskey challenged a federal tax; Shays' involved state debt and tax pressures
Whiskey took place before independence; Shays' occurred after the Civil War
Whiskey supported British troops; Shays' supported French troops
Whiskey ended the presidency; Shays' created the national bank

questions.question: Which early-republic sequence is in chronological order?
choices: Election of 1800 → Whiskey Rebellion → Washington's inauguration
Whiskey Rebellion → Election of 1800 → Washington's inauguration
Washington's inauguration → Whiskey Rebellion → Election of 1800
Washington's inauguration → Election of 1800 → Whiskey Rebellion

questions.question: A critic says the Constitution does not explicitly authorize a national bank. Which response reflects Hamilton's reasoning?
choices: A national bank requires no connection to Congress's listed powers
Only powers named word for word in the Constitution may be exercised
State approval is required before Congress can organize national finances
Implied powers can support means of carrying out listed federal powers

questions.question: What broader challenge links disputes about the bank, federal taxes, and the Sedition Act?
choices: Determining the western boundaries of the Louisiana Purchase
Defining the new national government's authority and limits
Negotiating military alliances with Britain's European rivals
Expanding political participation through changes in state voting laws
